source_coverage_review.review_evidence: Every line on the three-year consolidated comprehensive income statement (page 125) and cash-flow statement (page 128) was mapped to a visible row or documented model subtotal.

adjusted_ebitda.note: Historical values are a reported EBITDA proxy (operating profit plus depreciation, amortisation and impairment); forecast values are test-only.

depreciation_and_amortisation.note: Historical depreciation, amortisation and impairment; forecast from a visible revenue ratio.

change_in_working_capital.note: Historical trade receivable, inventory and payable/provision cash-flow movements.

capex.note: Historical PP&E and intangible purchases; forecast from a visible revenue ratio.

tax.note: Historical cash taxes; forecast tax is formula-driven.

dividends_and_buybacks.note: Historical ordinary dividends; forecast is test-only.

debt_reconciliation.note: Instrument register reconciles to the supplied certification debt evidence, translated into USD at the last historical period-end rates. Was 26067 until 2026-07-26 — the untranslated sum of USD, EUR and GBP native balances, 904.1 below the workbook's own USD gross-debt row.

broker_pack.source_label: Illustrative local broker pack for architecture testing; historical values use official AstraZeneca reporting.
